name: Now Playing
description: Control Spotify from Orca: now playing, controls, search, playlists, queue and devices, in the sidebar. Needs Spotify Premium and a free Spotify developer app of your own.

settings.title: Spotify Client ID
settings.description: The Client ID of your own app at developer.spotify.com. The app needs the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback. The panel walks you through it.
